svg.title: One scheduled run of Profile Weather View
svg.desc: One scheduled run. Render job, no secrets: GitHub cron at 23 5,13,21 UTC, fetchWithRetry calls Open-Meteo (15 s timeout, four attempts, jitter), a Zod schema turns the JSON into weather, renderReadme (the pure core) rewrites the section, and updateReadme writes the file; if the runner is throttled, render-retry starts on a fresh runner. The README passes as an artifact to the publish job in the profile environment: publish.sh refuses changes outside the weather section, signs and verifies the commit with an SSH key, and pushes it to the profile README with a contents-only token.
